verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search service with a cloud offering, so a policy or control preventing customer data from being used for AI model training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-use commitment. Self-hosting and tenant-token access controls are adjacent features, not a training-data control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
